catalog.label: Client
catalog.assumptions: Traffic source. Not a served resource; never a bottleneck itself.

catalog.label: Load Balancer
catalog.assumptions: L7 LB (e.g. nginx/ELB-class), simple round robin, negligible CPU cost per request.

catalog.label: API Service
catalog.assumptions: Stateless app server, 4 vCPU, JSON over HTTP, simple business logic (no heavy computation).

catalog.label: Cache (Redis-class)
catalog.assumptions: In-memory KV store, single node, small values (<10KB). hit_ratio defaults to 0.8.

catalog.label: SQL Database (Primary)
catalog.assumptions: Postgres-class, 8 vCPU, indexed point reads/writes. Full scans are far slower than this models.

catalog.label: SQL Read Replica
catalog.assumptions: Async replica of a sql_primary. Serves reads only; writes must route to the primary.

catalog.label: Message Queue
catalog.assumptions: Kafka/SQS-class durable queue. Decouples producers from consumers (async edge).

catalog.label: Background Worker
catalog.assumptions: Consumes from a queue; heavier per-task cost than a request/response API service.

prompt.title: Design a URL Shortener
prompt.scenario: Design a service that takes a long URL and returns a short code that redirects to it. Reads (redirects) vastly outnumber writes (new shortlinks). Start simple, then make it survive real load.
